title: Whatever Happens
goal: Say that nothing changes your decision with repeated subjunctive formulas such as pase lo que pase and diga lo que diga.
grammar: reduplicated subjunctive: pase lo que pase

items: I can say that nothing changes my decision with formulas such as pase lo que pase and diga lo que diga.
I can build a formula with lo que, quien, donde, como and o no.
I can use the new words for firm decisions.
